findings.message: 1 line in "Finishing on your end date" has no quote from the guideline ("The pages do not say what else you need to do in this cas…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.

1 line in "If your final pay looks wrong" has no quote from the guideline ("The email address and the form are on the Final pay page;…"). Fine for app wording; an instruction should quote its source.
The guideline mentions 6 amounts the template never uses: 4 week, 2 day, 3 week, 6 week, 5 day, 8 day. Some may be background; check none were left out.
Nobody is named under "Reviewed by:", so the app shows "Not reviewed".
The saved guideline text is a web copy made by a fetch tool and may not be word-perfect, so a "quote not found" may be the copy's fault. Add the PDF to sources/ for exact checking.
